text:
```yaml
name: DCO Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  dco-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Run DCO check
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
        git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
        git fetch origin +refs/pull/${{ github.event.number }}/merge:pr-merge
        if ! git log --format='%B' pr-merge | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*Signed-off-by:'; then
          echo "::error::DCO sign-off required. Please add a Signed-off-by line to your commit message."
          echo "To sign off your commit, use the following format:"
          echo "- Commit using the `-s` or `--signoff` option:"
          echo "  git commit -s -m \"Your commit message\""
          echo "- Or manually add the sign-off line to your commit message:"
          echo "  git commit --amend --no-edit --signoff"
          exit 1
        fi
```
